evaluate_icl_prediction: evaluate an ICL prediction by comparing model outputs against gold answers across multiple turns
create_icl_evaluation: create an IclEvaluation instance with an EvaluationConfig for many-shot in-context learning evaluation
compute_exact_match: compute exact match score between gold answers and a single predicted answer
compute_f1_score: compute F1 score between gold answers and a predicted answer using token overlap
normalize_answer: normalize a text answer by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
